test_gtest_help_flag: test the gtest help flag output by running gtest_help_test with the --help flag
run_gtest_with_flag: run the gtest_help_test executable with a custom command-line flag and capture exit code and output
detect_bsd_os: detect whether the current operating system is BSD-based using the is_bsd_based_os function
test_gtest_internal_flag: test that gtest runs tests normally when an internal testing flag is supplied instead of help
validate_help_regex: validate the gtest help output matches the expected regex pattern for all standard flags
